cards.details: Life of Mahavira; consolidation of the Jaina Sangha and establishment of the Caturvidha Sangha.
Great famine in Magadha; Bhadrabahu migrates to the South (Sravanabelagola) with Chandragupta Maurya.
Formal split between Digambaras and Svetambaras solidified during the Valabhi Council.

items.title: S.W.A.P
items.decryption: Svetambaras wear white, preserve the Agamas, and emphasize ritual confession (Pratikramana).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Thinking Jainism began with Mahavira: Mahavira was the 24th Tirthankara; Jainism has ancient roots.
Confusing the councils: First council (Pataliputra) tried to compile Agamas, Second (Valabhi) formalised the sect divide.
Believing Digambaras follow the Agamas: They reject the canonical status of the Svetambara Agamas.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Structure

  • Caturvidha Sangha: Monks, Nuns, Laymen, Laywomen
  • Acharyas: Heads of monastic orders

Leadership

  • Ganas: Groups of monks under an Acharya
  • Gachchhas: Sub-sects

Schism Overview

  • The Great Schism: Triggered by the 12-year famine.
    • Svetambara: Remained in Magadha, led by Sthulabhadra; adopted white robes.
    • Digambara: Migrated to the South with Bhadrabahu; practiced strict asceticism (sky-clad).
